svg.title: Reach Multiplies Risk
svg.desc: What the AI can reach multiplies the impact of one weakness: a model alone has limited exposure, a model reading untrusted content can be manipulated, and a model with data and actions can leak data or act at scale.
svg.text: The more an AI can read, reach and do, the further one weakness travels.
Design security in: least access, filtered input, authentication, monitoring
One leak can stop the whole AI programme
